Hiring Process

At Paretix, we believe that hiring the right analysts is a critical step toward driving innovation and success.

1. HR Interview

Initial assessment of experience, motivation, and matching expectations.

2. Technical/Professional Interview

Written exam assessing SQL, Excel, Python, and analytical problem-solving.

3. Professional-Business Interview

Evaluation and try-out test for specific projects and teamwork.

4. Reliability & Recommendations

Final verification and background step.
